predictions.question: 1) Does a Liouville-consistent 10-15 keV -> 5 keV electrostatic retarding ion column (duoplasmatron + Wien filter + HDA energy filter + MEMS aperture/blanker + retarding immersion mini-lens) close the 5 keV brightness scaling gap uncovered in Exp91_budget_attack (_attack91.py) while respecting UHV breakdown, spherical/chromatic aberrations, and Exp72 IBIC efficiency? 2) How much does the Exp105 Mode-A selection yield (69.25% at isotropic sigma=3.8 nm) shift under realistic 3D anisotropic BCA straggle (Exp92 sigma_z=2.88 nm vs Exp91 Holmes sigma_z=5.27 nm), wafer surface truncation (z > 0), and stochastic 31P donor straggle?
predictions.success_rule: CD1, CD2, CD3, CD4, CD6 all PASS (historical audit exact, Laplace/ray-trace Liouville & Scherzer verified, breakdown-safe 5 keV column closes sigma_spot<=1.50 nm & sigma_tot<=3.80 nm & eta_IBIC>=0.99, and portable Exp57/105 yield engine reproduces 49/100 and 277/400 verbatim). CD5, CD7, CD8 are scientific hypotheses scored verbatim either way.

predictions.claim: Unified chain reproduces Exp66/71/72/81/82/91_budget_attack/92/105 anchors within 1e-4 rel error, and proves via Liouville reduced brightness conservation (B_r = tau_f * J / (pi * T_i)) that _attack91.py at E_land=5 keV, alpha=10 mrad, r=1.5 nm, T_i=1.0 eV, tau_f=0.25 has a brightness deficit > 1.7x (B_net(5 keV) < B_req / 1.7).

2D axisymmetric Laplace (spsolve) + DOP853 ray tracer conserves the Lagrange-Helmholtz Wronskian W = sqrt(Phi_0)*(r_g*r_a' - r_a*r_g') to < 1e-6 relative error, and Scherzer-integral C_c agrees with direct finite-difference chromatic ray tracing within < 5%.

Direct single-stage 32 um-pitch (D=18 um) 10->5 keV deceleration violates either UHV breakdown (E_max > 15 MV/m at WD<=0.1 mm) or spherical aberration (C_s > 50 mm at WD>=0.5 mm); whereas both Arch-B (0.50 mm-pitch immersion mini-lens, D=0.30 mm, WD~0.65 mm) and Arch-C (2-stage pre-retarded 32 um-pitch micro-lens, 10->5.5->5.0 keV, WD~0.08 mm) stay <= 12 MV/m with C_c <= 0.50 mm.

At least one breakdown-safe (E_max <= 12 MV/m), Liouville-consistent 10-15 -> 5 keV column configuration achieves sigma_spot <= 1.50 nm, sigma_tot <= 3.80 nm (with Exp92 BCA 3.259 nm straggle), IBIC eta(5 keV, 0.5 pF) >= 0.99, Wien 32PH+ separation >= 3x slit width, and HDA dE_FWHM <= 2.0 eV.

Upper-column extraction at 10-15 keV reduces Coulomb trajectory blur by >= 2.5x relative to 5 keV extraction, while single-beamlet simultaneous ion occupancy at 1 ion/ms is < 0.01 (intra-beamlet Boersch negligible).
Portable Exp42/44/48 yield engine reproduces Exp57 AUDIT_S5_N1024 = 49/100 (0.4900) and Exp105 S3.8_N1024 = 277/400 (0.6925) bit-for-bit.

At N=1024 (fixed donor at R_p=6.46 nm, wafer surface z>0), tighter Exp92 BCA depth (sigma_z=2.88 nm) raises yield above Exp105 isotropic 0.6925 (both ANISO_BCA_PURE in [0.74, 0.88] and ANISO_P91_BCA > 0.70), while broader Exp91 Holmes depth (sigma_z=5.27 nm) + surface loss lowers ANISO_P91_HOLMES below 0.65.
Including realistic stochastic 31P donor 3D straggle (correlated donor-to-cloud offset, z_D > 0) reduces Mode-A N=1024 yield by at least 0.15 absolute compared to fixed-donor ANISO_P91_BCA.

honest_5keV_bca_ceiling_note: With OBS-039 infinite-domain ZBL/iradina straggle (4.385 nm at 5 keV), sigma_total exceeds the 3.80 nm ceiling even at zero optical spot size (CD4_liouville_closed_5keV_window=False). Closing <=3.80 nm requires <=3 keV 31P+ with cryo-JFET <0.3 pF IBIC (OBS-071) or heavy-ion 121Sb+.

attack91_bugs_confirmed: Liouville violation: _attack91.py compared 5 keV spot B_req=7.22e4 against 10 keV B_net=7.96e4; exact B(5 keV)=B_r*5000=3.98e4 (1.81x deficit at alpha=10 mrad, Ti=1 eV).
Clamped straggle below 5 keV: np.interp clamped E=3,4 keV to 3.0 nm, creating artificial 5 keV minimum (fixed by Exp92 BCA + Exp72 IBIC).
Hybrid production bug: used Exp65 sigma=10 nm anchors (35000 shots, 34 specs) times 0.49 -> 6.05e5/day vs Exp105 self-consistent 2.92e7/day (48.2x off).
